rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for things being messy or in disarray.

example.jyutping: gaan1 fong2 gaau2 dou3 lyun6 zou1 zou1

rows.note: Use this for people or groups that are unruly because they do not follow rules.

example.english: This group of kids is disorderly and doesn't follow the rules.
example.traditional: 呢班細路真係唔守規矩。
example.jyutping: ni1 baan1 sai3 lou6 zan1 hai6 m4 sau2 kwai1 geoi2

rows.note: Use this stronger expression when disorderly means lawless or defiant, not for ordinary untidiness.

example.english: These people are truly disorderly and lawless.
example.jyutping: ni1 baan1 jan4 zan1 hai6 mou4 faat3 mou4 tin1

rows.note: Use this when a bodily or mental function is not operating normally, rather than when something is merely untidy.

example.english: My sleep schedule has been disorderly lately.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 zok3 sik1 m4 zing3 soeng4
